'''''Progress''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The painting depicted a gear set into [[Mineral/Legends|stone]] on the left side with streams of liquid [[Ore/Legends|metal]] on the right.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Progress'' appeared in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[2005]] expansion pack<ref name="Trials">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20050819.html|text=Growing Galaxies: The Trials of Obi-Wan set for Nov. 1st}}</ref> for the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be used as decoration in the player's house. It was obtained by inserting three [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-infused items&mdash;a spool of wire, a [[recording rod]], and a [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cube]]&mdash;into the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relic capable of transmogrification through the Force. These items were looted from the corpses of the various enemies found on Mustafar. The schematic which was used to create it listed it as [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] Painting 3.<ref name="SWG" />
